hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler vaults. Handles all swaps in beforeSwap by computing amounts from a parameterized bonding curve, depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Blocks native LP positions, donate, and unauthorized pool initialization via revert-only hooks.
